metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1983 · V
metas.description: A race of aliens arrives on Earth. Suspicious humans uncover their intentions and prepare to resist.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1967 · The Prisoner
metas.description: A former secret agent is abducted and taken to what looks like an idyllic village, but is actually a bizarre prison. He refuses to give his warders information while attempting to escape.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1981 · The Hitch Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy
metas.description: Arthur Dent and his friend, Ford Prefect, escape the destruction of Earth, only to face incredible trials, tribulations and adventures in space and time.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1984 · V: The Final Battle
metas.description: A small group of human resistance fighters fight a desperate guerilla war against the genocidal extra-terrestrials who dominate Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1993 · Space Ghost Coast to Coast
metas.description: Space Ghost, a superhero from a 1960s Hanna-Barbera cartoon, hosts his own talk show.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1973 · World on a Wire
metas.description: In the future, Simulacron, a computer project simulating reality, encounters strange occurrences after its leader's death. Dr. Stiller questions the sudden disappearance of a friend and wonders if Simulacron holds the answers.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1978 · Blake's 7
metas.description: A group of convicts and outcasts fight a guerrilla war against the totalitarian Terran Federation from a highly advanced alien spaceship.
